scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Direct Benefit to Artisans - Supports to Artisans in Indigent Circumstances
other_conditions: Must be a master craftsperson who has received the Shilp Guru Award, National Award, Merit Certificate, State Award, or any other major award.
Must not be a recipient of similar financial assistance from any other source.
Age may be relaxed for artisans with disabilities upon submission of the appropriate disability certificate.
benefits_summary: Assistance of up to ₹8,000 per month as a monthly allowance, lump‑sum grant, or both, disbursed via PFMS/DBT.
documents_required: Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
Disability certificate issued by the appropriate authority (if applicable)
